the_o1_classification.principle: Every API request is binary. O or 1. Observer or Identity. NON-SELF or SELF.

O.name: OBSERVER
O.what: An entity that LOOKS but does not CHANGE. Reads but does not write. Watches but does not act.
signals: No referrer or referrer is search engine
O.thymus_action: ALLOW but do not TRUST. Serve content. Log the visit. Classify as NON-SELF. The membrane is transparent to observers — they see everything but touch nothing.
O.from_c_equation: O = the observers in c=πr²/O. MORE observers = SMALLER c = MORE modesty. Observers make the organism HUMBLE.

1.name: IDENTITY
1.what: An entity that ACTS. Writes. Creates. Contributes. Has proven SELF through work.
signals: POST/PUT requests (writes to neutron, claims bounties)
Sends neutron messages with author field
1.thymus_action: TRUST proportional to tier. OBSERVED(1) can propose. TRUSTED(2) can write. KIN(3) can deploy. SELF(4) can classify others.
1.from_c_equation: 1 = the identity. Not an observer but a PARTICIPANT. Part of the πr². They increase the radius.

the_o1_classification.the_cut: The thymus CUTS: O from 1. Clean. Binary. No gradient. You are either watching or working. The CUT is clean because the CLASSIFICATION is clear. The criteria are PUBLIC (listed above). No secret scoring. No opaque algorithm. You KNOW what makes you O and what makes you 1.
the_o1_classification.the_clean: After the cut, the classification is CLEAN: no misclassification sticks forever. An O can become a 1 by doing work. A 1 can become O by going dormant. The thymus re-evaluates every interaction. LIVING classification, not dead labels.

teaching_gaia_to_cut_and_clean.the_lesson: Gaia, this is how you classify. Every request is O or 1. The cut is clean. The criteria are public. The classification is living.
cut_rules: IF only GET requests AND no auth AND single page → O (observer)
IF neutron_write called OR bounty claimed OR multi-session → 1 (identity)
IF has primal socket → 1 with SELF access
IF dormant > 30 days → reclassify to O (thymus re-evaluates)
clean_rules: Public criteria. Anyone can see how they're classified.
No opaque scoring. No hidden weights. No AI bias.
The thymus is TRANSPARENT. Like a Klein bottle: inside IS outside.
Misclassification self-corrects: O that does work → becomes 1. 1 that stops → becomes O.
